title: Roadmap Legibility State
description: Snapshot of the canonical roadmap count and recent work units (planned or sidequest) for scripts/roadmap_legibility.mjs to audit.

canonicalRoadmaps.description: How many documents/tables currently claim to be THE source-of-truth roadmap. Must be exactly 1 for a legible product; 0 or 2+ is fragmentation.

workUnits.description: Every planned roadmap-phase task and every energy-driven sidequest done in the audited window.

reconciliationCadenceDays.description: How often (in days) sidequest/burst work is folded back into the roadmap and re-prioritized. Null/absent means reconciliation is not scheduled at all.

linkOrOptOutRequired.description: Whether every work unit must carry a roadmapLink or an explicit optOutReason. Should stay true; false is an escape hatch to document, not a default.

maxReconciliationCadenceDays.description: The longest acceptable gap between reconciliation passes before the audit flags drift risk.

id.description: Stable identifier for this unit of work (roadmap slug for planned items, a short descriptive id for sidequests).

kind.description: planned = came from a roadmap phase directly. sidequest = energy-driven work outside the current phase plan.

roadmapLink.description: Slug of the canonical roadmap item this unit advances, mirroring the Roadmap-Item: <slug> PR trailer. Mutually exclusive with optOutReason.

optOutReason.description: Explicit reason this unit does not need a roadmap link (chore/docs/hotfix/spike), mirroring Roadmap-Item: none — <reason>. Mutually exclusive with roadmapLink.

spawnedItems.description: Count of new, durable work items this unit generated (e.g. a sidequest that surfaced three follow-on tasks).

spawnedItemsCaptured.description: Count of the spawned items above that were actually created as roadmap items (or explicitly opted out), mirroring the Roadmap-Spawns: trailer rule for planning docs.

items.description: A real artifact reference, e.g. commit:<sha>, pr:<number>, receipt:<id>.

status.description: Free-text status. Recognized pending words: todo, planned, backlog, parked, blocked. Recognized active words: in-progress, active, done, shipped, merged, landed. Active statuses require non-empty progressEvidence.
